intended_behavior: Before starting the asynchronous event loop, this method should check if an invocation is already in progress on the same Agent instance. If so, it should raise a concurrency exception to prevent concurrent executions that would corrupt the internal state. It should maintain any concurrency locks or flags during the invocation and release them after completion or error, preserving existing streaming, callbacks, and telemetry logic.

This method should also enforce concurrency control by detecting concurrent invocations and raising a concurrency exception if one is in progress. It can delegate the concurrency handling to stream_async or re-check before calling it.

The constructor should initialize concurrency control primitives such as an asyncio.Lock or an atomic boolean flag to be used by invoke_async and stream_async to enforce serialized invocation and protect internal state.

Add a new dedicated concurrency exception class (e.g., AgentConcurrencyException or AgentInvocationInProgress) that is raised when concurrent invocations are attempted on the same Agent instance, providing clear and specific feedback to clients and users of the Agent API.
